snippet.title: 🍻👊 Secondhand Lions 2003 Hub and Garth McCann Teach the Bar Bullies a Lesson

A bunch of loudmouth punks in a Texas bar think they can push anyone around—until they pick a fight with Hub and Garth McCann! 😤🍻

These two "retired" uncles look like ordinary old men. But they are former adventurers. Their skills are far from rusty. When the troublemakers get aggressive, Hub and Garth handle them without breaking a sweat—precision punches, dodging swings, and teaching those young thugs a lesson they will never forget! 👊😎

Within a minute, the bullies are on the floor—embarrassed, frustrated, and utterly defeated. And Walter watches in awe, realizing his uncles are the real deal. 🔥

The Setup 🎯
Secondhand Lions (2003) is a heartwarming coming-of-age story. Walter (Haley Joel Osment) is a shy boy dropped off to live with his eccentric great-uncles, Hub (Robert Duvall) and Garth (Michael Caine). The uncles are rumored to have a mysterious past—bank robbers, adventurers, maybe even killers. Walter does not know what to believe. But when he sees them fight, he starts to understand. 💀

The Fight 💥
The bar scene is a perfect introduction to the uncles' hidden talents. They do not start the fight. They do not want trouble. But when trouble finds them, they do not back down. They fight with skill. They fight with experience. They fight with the confidence of men who have faced far worse than a few drunk bullies. The scene is funny. It is thrilling. It is a reminder that you should never judge a book by its cover. 🔥

Why This Scene Works 🎬
Secondhand Lions is not just a family film. It is a story about legacy. About the stories we tell. About the heroes we admire. Hub and Garth are not just uncles. They are legends. And this scene proves it. The film was written and directed by Tim McCanlies. It was released in 2003. It was a critical and commercial success. It has become a beloved classic. And the bar scene is one of its most memorable moments. 😎

The Legacy 🏆
Secondhand Lions is a film that families watch together. It is a film that makes you laugh. It makes you cry. And it makes you believe in heroes. The bar scene is a perfect example. It is not just about violence. It is about standing up for what is right. And it is about two old men proving that they still have a few tricks up their sleeves. 💀

snippet.title: Polisi Ungkap Pengakuan Donatur yang Pasok Dana ke Geng Listyo Sigit Cs, Singgung soal Dugaan Makar
snippet.description:
Download aplikasi berita TribunX di Play Store atau App Store untuk dapatkan pengalaman baru

TRIBUN-VIDEO.COM - Direktorat Tindak Pidana Umum Bareskrim Polri mengungkap fakta baru dalam kasus dugaan makar yang menyeret mantan Kapolri Jenderal Pol Listyo Sigit Prabowo.

Direktur Tindak Pidana Umum Bareskrim Polri Brigjen Pol Susatyo Purnomo Condro menyebut, ada pemberi dana operasional yang diduga dipakai para tersangka untuk melakukan dugaan makar.

Dari pengakuan pemberi dana, kepolisian menyebut pihak tersebut tidak mengetahui uang yang diberikan digunakan untuk perbuatan makar.

"Enggak tahu itu (pemberi dana). Enggak tahu itu untuk apa," kata Susatyo saat ditemui di Mabes Polri, Jakarta Selatan, Selasa (25/11/2026).

Susatyo menjelaskan, kelompok Listyo Sigit dan para tersangka lainnya merupakan lingkaran kecil atau close group.

Kelompok tersebut disebut tidak menggunakan struktur organisasi seperti pada umumnya.

Sebaliknya, mereka diduga menjalankan kegiatan melalui tim khusus dengan orang-orang tertentu.

"Dia (kelompok ini) tidak menggunakan struktural seperti yang normal, gitu. Tapi menggunakan tim kecil, sifatnya khusus, orangnya khusus, dan memang lingkar, gitu," ucap Susatyo.

Sementara itu, dalam kesempatan berbeda, Kabareskrim Polri Komjen Pol Asep Safrudin mengungkap dugaan peran tersangka Irjen Pol Ahrie Sonta Nasution.

Ahrie diduga menyusun poin-poin arahan rapat yang kemudian diserahkan kepada tersangka Irjen Pol Slamet Uliandi.

Ahrie juga diduga menentukan target penyadapan, memerintahkan penyadapan, hingga menerima laporan harian.

"(ASN) memerintahkan surveillance kepada tersangka TK, menggerakkan demonstrasi sesuai tema yang ditentukan melalui agen action, memerintahkan penggalangan pihak eksternal, mencarikan dana operasional, serta memerintahkan penghapusan server untuk menghilangkan jejak," ujar Asep dalam jumpa pers, Senin (23/11/2026).

Kasus dugaan makar ini berbeda dengan perkara penyadapan ilegal terhadap nomor telepon Presiden Prabowo Subianto.

Kasus penyadapan ditangani Direktorat Tindak Pidana Siber Bareskrim Polri, sedangkan perkara dugaan makar merupakan pengembangan dari penyelidikan kasus tersebut.

Dalam kasus penyadapan, Polri menetapkan empat orang tersangka, yakni Listyo Sigit Prabowo, Ahrie Sonta Nasution, Slamet Uliandi, dan Eko Hadi Santoso.

Penyidik menerapkan sejumlah pasal terkait dugaan penyadapan, penghilangan data elektronik, akses ilegal, serta dugaan turut serta melakukan tindak pidana.

Ancaman hukumannya mulai dari enam hingga 10 tahun penjara, sesuai pasal yang disangkakan.

Sementara dalam perkara dugaan makar, Polri menetapkan enam orang sebagai tersangka.

Mereka diduga melakukan makar, baik secara langsung maupun dengan menyuruh atau menggerakkan orang lain.

Perbuatan tersebut bertujuan merampas kemerdekaan Presiden, membuat Presiden tidak mampu menjalankan pemerintahan, atau menggulingkan pemerintah.

Para tersangka juga diduga melakukan permufakatan jahat atau persiapan untuk melancarkan serangan sebagai bagian dari rencana makar.

Atas dugaan tersebut, penyidik menerapkan Pasal 191 dan/atau Pasal 193 dan/atau Pasal 196 KUHP, juncto Pasal 160 KUHP, serta ketentuan lainnya.

Ancaman hukumannya berupa pidana mati, penjara seumur hidup, atau penjara paling lama 20 tahun. (Tribun-Video.com)

snippet.title: 🧈 “Technically, You’re Sautéed!” – Kramer’s Butter Shave Goes Horribly Wrong 💀🔥
snippet.description:
🧈 “Technically, You’re Sautéed!” – Kramer’s Butter Shave Goes Horribly Wrong 💀🔥

📝 Description:

Kramer has found a new life hack, and it is absolutely unhinged. 😳🧈 He runs out of shaving cream, so he borrows Jerry’s butter — and starts shaving with it. Jerry walks in, sees Kramer buttering his own face, and asks the obvious question: “Why are you buttering your face?” Kramer’s answer? “I’m shaving with it.” 💀

Then he insists Jerry feel his face. Jerry refuses. Kramer keeps pushing. Finally, Jerry touches it and admits it’s a close shave. Kramer is triumphant: butter is “vastly superior to any commercial shaving cream.” 😂🔥

But it gets worse. Kramer goes up to the roof to get some sun — with the butter. He uses it like suntan oil, and by the time he comes back down, he’s completely cooked. “I think I cooked myself.” Jerry looks at his skin and deadpans: “Technically, you’re sautéed.” 💀💀💀

Kramer says he has to keep his skin moist so he doesn’t dry out. Did a doctor tell him that? No — he read it in Bon Appétit. 🍽️😭 Then he keeps slathering on more butter because he’s “got to stay juicy.” Later, he’s covered in oregano and parmesan, and it’s all sticking because of the butter. Jerry just stares at him: “Look at me.” 💀🔥

It’s peak Seinfeld — Kramer turning butter into shaving cream, suntan oil, and a full Italian seasoning crust, while Jerry reacts with pure exhausted disbelief. If you love 90s sitcom chaos and unforgettable Kramer moments, this clip is an absolute must-watch! 🍿🔥

snippet.title: LSP Mangkir, Sidang Etik Tetap Berjalan Walau Tersangka Tidak Hadir | Kabar Petang
snippet.description:
Kabar Petang, https://www.tvOnenews.com - LSP Mangkir, Sidang Etik Tetap Berjalan Walau Tersangka Tidak Hadir | Kabar Petang


Mantan Kapolri Jenderal LSP menolak hadir dalam Sidang Komisi Kode Etik Profesi (KKEP) Polri yang digelar di Gedung Divisi Propam Mabes Polri, Kamis (26/11/2026). Akibat penolakan tersebut, persidangan ditunda dan dijadwalkan kembali pada Senin, 30 November 2026.

Polri telah melayangkan pemanggilan kedua kepada LSP untuk memberikan kesempatan menyampaikan keterangan dan pembelaan terkait dugaan pelanggaran kode etik dalam kasus penyadapan ilegal yang mengarah pada dugaan makar terhadap Presiden Prabowo Subianto.

Polri menegaskan, apabila LSP kembali tidak hadir, sidang kode etik tetap dilanjutkan tanpa kehadiran yang bersangkutan hingga majelis menjatuhkan putusan. Konsekuensinya, LSP kehilangan hak mengajukan banding dan putusan bersifat final serta mengikat.
